validation: Global scaffold/nonisomeric identity groups; no query group from any task can enter multi-task fitting. Fixed training duration. Official valid is a historically reused secondary diagnostic, never early stopping.
comparators: Exact v23 neural architecture/recipe refit under the same train-only outer groups. This is NOT a refit of the unavailable entire historical v23 ensemble. Reconstruct historical ensemble valid predictions only for secondary evidence.
gate: Candidate task needs positive mean CV improvement over neural comparator and >=2/3 nonnegative fold deltas; choose at most one of two fixed fusion weights with historically reused valid positive gain. Aggregate uncertainty must be reported; no guaranteed official score gain.
limitations: Historical labels have been repeatedly used; these folds are not a new independent dataset
Official total-score formula and task weights unknown
Fixed CV comparator is only the v23 neural component
